CustomField.description:
Operational field used by Subscription teams to record the total number of licensed users/seats sold on an Opportunity.
This field is primarily used for:
account management allocation renewal ownership decisions operational visibility/reporting
For multi-product Opportunities, enter the combined total across all applicable subscription products.
Example:
5 GAR licenses + 5 GRR licenses = 10 total users
This is a manual/static field and does not currently roll automatically to Renewal Opportunities.
This field should not be used as a contractual source of truth where seat counts already exist within CPQ products, Quote Line Items, or Product Terms.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the total number of licensed users/seats included across all subscription products on this Opportunity.
CustomField.label: Number of Users
